Pages in this section are generated from the same registry that powers `woco describe` and shell completion,
so they always match the CLI. Run `woco <command> --help` for the same information in your terminal.

## Commands

| Command | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`init`](./init/) | Generate .wombo-combo/config.json in the current project |
| [`launch`](./launch/) | Launch a wave of agents to implement features |
| [`resume`](./resume/) | Resume a previously stopped wave |
| [`status`](./status/) | Show the status of the current wave |
| [`retry`](./retry/) | Retry a failed agent |
| [`merge`](./merge/) | Merge verified agents and publish a changelog entry / PR |
| [`cleanup`](./cleanup/) | Remove worktrees and session artifacts |
| [`history`](./history/) | List/view past wave results from .wombo-combo/history/ |
| [`eval`](./eval/) | Score a completed session (weighting/routing/steering/flow) |
| [`usage`](./usage/) | Show token usage statistics from .wombo-combo/usage.jsonl |
| [`abort`](./abort/) | Kill a single running agent without affecting the rest of the wave |
| [`upgrade`](./upgrade/) | Check for updates and upgrade wombo |
| [`logs`](./logs/) | Pretty-print agent logs from .wombo-combo/logs/&lt;feature-id&gt;.log |
| [`tasks`](./tasks/) | Manage tasks file |
| [`help`](./help/) | Show help text |
| [`version`](./version/) | Print version and exit (also: -v, -V) |
| [`describe`](./describe/) | Emit JSON schema of a command's arguments and flags |
| [`quest`](./quest/) | Manage quests (scoped missions with their own task sets) |
| [`genesis`](./genesis/) | Decompose a project vision into quests |
| [`wishlist`](./wishlist/) | Quick-capture ideas for later |
| [`replay`](./replay/) | List and show recorded agent sessions from .wombo-combo/replays/ |
| [`team`](./team/) | Multi-developer task claims: claim, release, status |
| [`comment`](./comment/) | Comments on tasks and quests: add, list, show |
| [`completion`](./completion/) | Shell completions (install, uninstall, or emit script) |
| [`daemon`](./daemon/) | Manage the persistent background daemon |

## Global flags

Available on every command unless the command defines a flag of the same name.

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
